evidence.scope: One existing Android USB connection to the owner's computer; no role switch, cable transition, gadget configuration or device write was performed

interpretation: DWC3 carries the current stock Android device-mode connection; this is stronger evidence than enabled DT nodes alone
Both UDCs are registered; the observation does not establish mux register values, boot ordering, OTG policy or all cable scenarios
Reported PHY runtime_status is not a direct measurement of its power rail or an error diagnosis
No conclusion about successful operation of the experimental Linux 6.18 kernel follows from these stock Android observations
